paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash kum sawmnih-le-thum alal kum in Jehu tapa Jehoahaz Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jehoahaz
english: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate ama'n leng ahih samta a, apaisan nawn kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael khut leh Hazael tapa Ben-hadad khut ah adamsung teng ape vekta hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

paite: Jehoahaz in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, TOUPA'N athu angaihkhiaksak a; Israel simmoh a om a, Siria kumpipa'n amau asimmohdan lah amu kilkel ngal a.
english: Jehoahaz begged Yahweh, and Yahweh listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte hondampa apia a, huchi in Siriate nuai a pan apawtkhia uh. Israel suante tuma lam bang in amau inn ah a-om kinken uhi.
english: (Yahweh gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

paite: Himahleh Israelte thil ana hihkhialsak a Jeroboam inkote khelhnate apaisan kei ua, ahih lailai zosop ua; Samaria ah Asherah song leng a-om lailai hi.
english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

paite: Jehoahaz in amite lak a sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga, kangtalai sawm leh sepaih singkhat chih louh aneih aphalsak ngal kei a; Siria kumpipa'n ahihmang vek a, leivui chilzan bang in abawl hi.
english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

paite: Huchi in Jehoahaz tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Hichi in Jehoahaz bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoash alalta hi.
english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash kum sawmthum-le-sagih alal kum in Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-guk alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jehoash
english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou pipi ana hih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei a, aching lailai zosop hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.

paite: Huchi in Jehoash tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh akisual lai ua athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Jeroboam alaltutphah ah atu a, Jehoas bel Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
english: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

paite: Elisha achi ana a, sihpih ding khop chinatna ahi. Huchi in akiang ah Israel kumpipa Jehoash ahohsuk a, akah a, "Aw, ka pa, ka pa, Israelte kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite," achi hi.
heading: Elisha Sihna
english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Thalpeu leh thaltangte hon la in," achi a; ama'n thalpeu leh thaltangte ahon la hi.
english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

paite: Israelte kumpipa kiang ah, "Thalpeuh tung ah na khut nga in," achi hi. Huchi in akhut anga a; Elisha in kumpipa khut tung ah akhut anga hi.
english: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

paite: Ama'n, "Suahlam tohlet hong in," achi hi. Huchi in ahong hi. Elisha in, "Kap in," achi a, akap hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hotkhiakna thaltang leh Siria a pan hotkhiakna thaltang; Aphek ah na zoh tanpha in Siriate na sual ding hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “Yahweh’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

paite: "Thaltangte hon la in," achi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huai in leitual sun dih," achi a; huchi in thumvei asun a, atawpta hi.
english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

paite: Huchi in Pathian mipa atung ah aheh a, "Ngavei ahihkeileh gukvei na sut ding ei ve; huchi in Siriate mangthang vek khop in na zou ding. Himahleh Siriate thumvei kia zou ding na hita ve," achi hi.
english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha asi a, avui uh. Kum hong kivei in, Moab pawlte'n agam uh ahong dou uhi.
english: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

paite: Mi khat avui laitak un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mi pawl khat amu uhi. Huchi in huai mi Elisha han sung ah akhe mawk ua; aluang in Elisha guhte asukkhaktak in, ahong hing nawn a, adingtouta hi.
english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz damsung teng in Israelte anuaisiah hi.
heading: Israel Leh Siria Kal A Kidouna
english: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a thu akhun ziak in amau ahehpih a, alainat a, azahtak a, amau ahihmang nuam kei a, akiang a pan apaikhe kei hi.
english: But Yahweh was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael asi a; asik in atapa Ben-hadad alal hi.
english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash in Hazael tapa Ben-hadad in apa Jehoahaz adou a, khua alaksakte asut nawn a, Joash in thumvei azou a, Israel gam khuate alakik nawn hi.
english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.
